text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue was packed to the brim with people.
Everyone eagerly anticipated the birth of a new legend.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I want Brian to win.
Because that's way more exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going with Rudolf. The 'Emperor' is absolute.
That legend won't be broken, I tell ya."

Ehehe, 'scuse me~!
Can Maya go to the front~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a tiny young lady.
Haha, go right ahead, after you.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, aren't you a cutie?
Hey, tell me, which one of us are you a fan of?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya's on Team Mayano Top Gun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, no matter how many times I try,
I just can't picture myself beating Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: However, every time I see that shimmering haze, my heart begins to beat clamorously.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: I believe in your victory too.
I believe in your victory too

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this is what I have been
yearning for all along.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day...
to surpass Symboli Rudolf...!
